text:
ben: heads-up — replay harness is showing ~15% lower p50 throughput on a100 image vs rtx image for the same model + batch config. suspect driver/CUDA/container mismatch; starting an env parity checklist.

maria: can you paste the docker image + driver versions? :eyes:

ben: image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference/runtime:2026-03-17-gpu (digest sha256:abc123...), kernel: 5.15.0-67, nvidia driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 9.1.2, container runtime runc 1.1.4. replay used synthetic traffic (replay-harness v2) with prefix caching disabled.

lee: please also include kernel selector logs and the perf sampling output (nsight or perf). without those we can't tell if it picked a different matmul kernel.

ben: here's the kernel selector snippet we captured:
```
KERNEL SELECTOR: model=decoder_big, seq=1024, batch=8
candidate kernels: {fp16_gemm_fast, int8_gemm_sparse, fp32_shmm}
selected: int8_gemm_sparse (reason: estimated FLOPs lower after quant hint)
```

dan: that smells like different cudnn heuristics. minor CUDA/cudnn patch levels can flip autotune choices. did the replay machine have CUDNN_AUTOTUNE enabled?

ben: we left AUTOTUNE=1 (default). replay host A (a100) had cudnn 9.1.2, host B (rtx) had 9.0.4. also noticed different libcuda.so symlinks. :thinking:

maria: checklist proposal — items to lock for apples-to-apples:
- same container image digest
- same nvidia driver minor (535.x vs 535.x)
- same CUDA minor (12.1) and cuDNN patch
- same runc / container runtime + OCI hooks
- identical kernel boot flags (no_compact_mode, power governor pinned)
- same env vars: CUDNN_AUTOTUNE, REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT, TF_CUDA_JIT
- consistent KV cache warmup (e.g., first N requests)

lee: also add: disable cudnn autotune during one run (for deterministic kernels) and enable in another (for best perf). that gives us bounds.

perf-bot: replay-run started on a100-1 with image sha256:abc123... matrix: driver=535.86 cudnn=9.1.2 cuda=12.1 prefix_cache=off :rocket:

ben: quick mitigation: forced kernel path with env var REDWOOD_KERNEL_HINT=prefer_fp16 — forcing fp16 matmul on the a100 aligned the p50 within 3% in the quick smoke run.

dan: good signal — long-term we may want the runtime to log selection reason and a hash of the kernel config so tests can compare selection vectors rather than just final latency.

maria: agree. add a test harness step: capture kernel-selection hash + NVTX ranges for each trace and store alongside metrics. makes reruns comparable.

ben: plan: I'll run full matrix (image x driver x cudnn patch x prefix_cache) with 3 repeats each, collect kernel hashes + nvprof traces, KV-cache warmup = 200 requests. will post spreadsheet link later today.

lee: FYI — small gotcha: driver 535.86 on older BIOS has a different enumeration behavior; if you see non-deterministic PCI bus order, set NVIDIA_PERSISTENCE_MODE=1 or use nvidia-smi -pm. saved us before.

ben: thanks — adding to checklist. will update with results by EOD. :thumbsup:
